source: Dates/types transcribed from the NASA GSFC Five Millennium Canon of Solar/Lunar Eclipses (Espenak & Meeus, eclipse.gsfc.nasa.gov) and cross-checked against the Meeus ch. 54 computation in src/utils/eclipses.js. gamma/magnitude, where present, are NASA canon values for well-documented solar eclipses; entries without them use the computed values (agree with the canon to ~0.01). Visibility text is a summary — check eclipse.gsfc.nasa.gov or timeanddate.com before travelling.
